claims: NASA's Artemis II crewed test flight successfully launched on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
NASA's Artemis II mission carried four astronauts around the Moon and back.
NASA's Artemis II mission lifted off from Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center.
NASA's Artemis II mission is the first crewed journey to the Moon since 1972.
NASA's Artemis II mission goal is a ~10-day test flight preparing for future Moon landings.
NASA's Artemis II crew consists of Commander Reid Wiseman, Pilot Victor Glover, Mission Specialist Christina Koch, and CSA Specialist Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis III is currently scheduled for mid-2027 to land astronauts on the lunar surface
